summary.text: Jeff Backer is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 9A who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He first won a House seat in 2014 and faces Democrat Nicholas Hanson in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Backer lost the 2010 general election for the Minnesota State Senate to incumbent Keith Langseth (DFL).
In 2014 he defeated Nancy Taffe in the Republican primary and incumbent Jay McNamar in the general election for House District 12A.
Backer won the 2022 general election for District 9A over Nancy Jost and the 2024 Republican primary over Boone Carlson, then the 2024 general election over Michael Ziomko.
